_doc: Single source of truth for pattern-based code rules. Read by src/test/.../ArchitectureTest.kt (build gate) and .claude/hooks/guard-edit.mjs (blocks AI edits early). 'allowedIn' are sub-packages of org.tnozamas.skyatlaz (slash separated) where the pattern is permitted.

rules.message: Use the logger (Skyatlaz.LOGGER or a module logger) instead of printing.
User-facing text must use Tr.tr(key) with a key in en_us.json (docs/I18N.md).
Colors must come from ui.theme tokens, never hex literals or ChatFormatting.
HTTP/network access must go through api.http (shared client, cache, rate limits).
Never block threads. Use the core scheduler or async executors.
Do not create threads/executors directly; use the core scheduler/executor.
